description: Self-taught full-stack software & hardware developer specializing in rapid prototyping, AI integration, and interactive web tools.
summary:
# ORBITAL – Astronaut Health Monitoring Software

ORBITAL is a health monitoring software prototype designed to support astronaut wellbeing and health awareness during space missions. Space environments expose astronauts to challenges such as microgravity, isolation, disrupted sleep cycles, dehydration, and physical stress. ORBITAL aims to bring essential health information together in one centralized and easy-to-understand dashboard.

The platform focuses on monitoring important health indicators, including heart rate, blood oxygen saturation (SpO2), core body temperature, blood pressure, and stress index. It presents health information through visual cards, charts, and risk indicators. Its alert system is designed to highlight potential concerns, including hypoxia, dehydration, and microgravity-related fatigue, using green, yellow, and red warning levels.

ORBITAL also aims to support daily astronaut wellbeing through routine tracking, health instructions, and activity monitoring. The current prototype uses clearly labelled synthetic data to demonstrate its interface and monitoring capabilities. It does not currently use real astronaut data, physical sensors, or NASA systems.


Our vision is to contribute to safer human space exploration through accessible, organized, and intelligent astronaut health monitoring.
